cues: Every morning when I wake, dear Lord, a little prayer I make.
Notice little: modest in length and ambition, said daily, not in a crisis.
And Dear Lord, the way you start a letter to someone you know.
The request is startlingly small: that God keep his loving eye on all poor creatures born to die.
Not to do anything; just to look, with love.
Poor means pitiable, and creatures means everything created, animals included.
The only qualification is that we are mortal.
